title: 1980s Indigo Dyed Noragi Jacket with Sashiko Repair
description: Authentic 1980s Japanese noragi work jacket in deep fermented plant indigo. Features visible sashiko geometric hand-reinforcement on left elbow by a Kyoto artisan. Rich natural wash fade developed over four decades. Crisp hem, clean seams, freshly steam-sanitised. 100% pure long-staple cotton. Chemical-free naturally fermented indigo. Zero synthetic elastane or microplastics.

title: Raw Kanjivaram Brocade Silk Saree — 1982 Heritage Textile
description: An extraordinary 1982 vintage deep emerald and raw golden Zari Kanjivaram silk saree in exceptional condition. Woven with 100% pure silk and pure gold zari. Classic temple border with intricate peacock motif. The natural sheen and hand-woven texture are unmistakable. Original blouse piece included. Never been stitched, stored flat in cedar chest.

title: Japanese Selvedge Denim Chore Jacket — Worn Indigo
description: Vintage Japanese selvedge denim chore jacket with beautiful worn indigo honeycombs and original copper button hardware. The natural fading tells a story of genuine use. Classic oversized silhouette, structured collar, chest patch pocket. Machine washed, thoroughly cleaned, no odour. A collector's piece for serious denim enthusiasts.

title: Raw Selvedge Drill Overshirt — 1997 Muji Archive (Size L)
description: Rare 1997 Muji raw selvedge cotton drill overshirt in flawless Grade A condition. Heavy natural ecru canvas weight fabric with visible selvedge ID on interior seam. Minimal wear, no pills, brass snap buttons all functional. Oversized silhouette suits M-XL. This is not a repro — the original label and care tag are intact.

title: Handmade Embroidered Phulkari Dupatta — Punjab Heritage
description: Hand-embroidered Phulkari dupatta in vibrant saffron and crimson with traditional floral motifs stitched on undyed khaddar cotton base. Made by a master embroiderer in Patiala. Each stitch placed by hand over approximately 40 hours. Completely unworn — purchased from artisan collective and never used. Fringed edges intact.

title: Leather Tote — Naturally Tanned Vegetable Leather, Mumbai
description: Handstitched tote bag crafted from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather sourced from a small Mumbai tannery. Bought in 2020, used lightly for about 8 months, then stored. Developed a beautiful natural patina. All hardware in brass. Interior has one zippered pocket and two slip pockets. No scratches, clean interior, authentic leather smell.

title: Hand-turned Sheesham Wood Stool — Heritage Joinery
description: Handcrafted solid sheesham (Indian rosewood) low stool with natural wood grain and warm honey finish. Made using traditional mortise-and-tenon joinery without any metal fasteners or adhesives. Turned on a foot-powered lathe in a Jaipur workshop. Slight surface texture is intentional — a mark of hand-made authenticity. Weighs 3.2 kg. Load bearing up to 120 kg.

title: Unglazed Terracotta Vase — Khurja Pottery Collective
description: Handthrown unglazed terracotta vase by master potter Raju Prajapati of the Khurja Pottery Collective. Features a tall cylindrical form with subtle texture from the potter's fingers during shaping. Natural clay colour with warm earthy tones. Watertight interior sealed with beeswax. Dimensions: 28 cm tall, 12 cm diameter. Each piece unique — yours may vary slightly.

title: Handwoven Dhurrie Rug — Natural Undyed Wool, 4x6 ft
description: Flat-woven dhurrie rug handwoven on a traditional pit loom by weavers of the Mirzapur weaving cluster. 100% undyed natural wool in its original cream, brown and grey shades. Zero chemical dyes or synthetic fibres. Tight even weave, 4 ft x 6 ft. Reversible. Suitable for indoor or covered outdoor spaces. Can be hand-washed.

title: Sterling Silver Jhumka Earrings — Rajasthani Filigree
description: Handcrafted 92.5 sterling silver jhumka earrings with intricate Rajasthani filigree work. Each pair takes 3 days to make. Features traditional ghungroo bell droplets and a meenakari enamel flower at the top in cobalt blue. Fish-hook clasps with safety backs. Presented in a handstitched muslin pouch. Hallmarked 925 silver.

title: Madhubani Painting — Mithila Fish Motif on Handmade Paper
description: Original Madhubani painting by Pushpa Devi, a National Award winning artist from Madhubani district. Fish motif representing prosperity, painted with natural pigments ground from minerals and plants on handmade paper. Approximately 40 cm x 60 cm. Unframed, rolled in a protective tube. Signed and dated by the artist on the reverse. Certificate of authenticity included.

title: Brass Dhokra Figurine — Tribal Lost-Wax Cast Owl
description: Dhokra lost-wax cast brass owl figurine made by Kondapalli tribal artisans. This ancient casting technique produces rough-textured, one-of-a-kind pieces. 8 cm tall, solid brass, significant weight. The owl is a traditional symbol of wisdom and guardian of thresholds. No two pieces are identical — yours will differ slightly from the photograph. Completely natural finish, no plating.

title: Fundamentals of Physics — Halliday, Resnick & Walker (10th Ed)
description: Halliday, Resnick and Walker Fundamentals of Physics 10th Edition. Good condition — some highlighting in chapters 1-5 only, no torn pages, spine intact. All problems complete. Ideal for JEE, NEET and university physics. Bought for ₹950 at college bookstore. Perfect for a first-year engineering student.

title: Architectural Splendours of Vijayanagara — Marg Publications 1988
description: Rare first edition hardbound Marg Publications monograph, 1988. Comprehensive photographic and scholarly study of the Vijayanagara Empire's architectural heritage at Hampi. 220 pages with 180 black and white and 24 colour plates. Cloth cover with gold debossed lettering. Minor shelf wear to spine, all pages clean and undamaged. A collector's reference.

title: Data Structures and Algorithms — Cormen (CLRS) 3rd Edition
description: Introduction to Algorithms (CLRS) 3rd Edition by Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest, and Stein. Essential for CS engineering, competitive programming and placements. Light pencil annotations in first three chapters, all erasable. Binding strong, all 1312 pages present. This book is commonly called the 'bible of algorithms'. Bought for ₹1,450, selling to clear shelf space after graduation.

title: Manto Ki Kahaniyaan — Complete Stories of Saadat Hasan Manto
description: Complete collected short stories of Saadat Hasan Manto in Urdu script, Rajkamal Prakashan edition. One of the most important Urdu literary collections ever published. Includes Toba Tek Singh, Khol Do, Bu and all major works. Hardcover, well preserved, minor yellowing at page edges typical of its age. Owned by a literature professor, gifted to him by a student in 1991.

title: Organic Chemistry — Morrison & Boyd (6th Ed) for JEE
description: Morrison & Boyd Organic Chemistry 6th Edition — the gold standard reference for JEE Advanced organic chemistry. Lightly used, no missing pages, excellent binding. Some chapter headings highlighted. This is the original Prentice Hall edition, not a photocopy. Perfect for JEE aspirants or B.Sc chemistry students. Free shipping to anywhere in India.

title: The God of Small Things — First Edition Paperback, Arundhati Roy
description: First Indian paperback edition of The God of Small Things by Arundhati Roy, IndiaInk / HarperCollins 1997. This was Roy's debut novel that won the Booker Prize. Lightly yellowed at edges as expected for its age. All text completely clear, no annotations. A piece of Indian literary history. Spine mildly worn, cover shows shelf use. For the serious reader or collector.

title: Reclaimed Burma Teak Studio Lounge Chair — 1970s Chandigarh
description: Mid-century teak lounge chair rescued from a 1970s Chandigarh government bungalow. Frame fully stripped, re-oiled with raw linseed and re-caned with natural rattan. New upholstery in heavy natural ecru linen by a Jaipur upholstery studio. Structurally sound, no wobble, joints re-glued with marine epoxy. Ready to live another 50 years. Ships flat-packed.

title: Reclaimed Oak Monolith Table Lamp with Brass Fixture
description: Modernist sculptural table lamp crafted from salvaged railway sleeper oak timber with brushed raw brass lamp housing. The wood section retains its original surface texture and grain pattern, sealed with matte danish oil. Warm ambient 3000K LED bulb included. Rewired with fabric braided cable, standard Indian plug. 42 cm tall. Approx 2.8 kg.

title: Upcycled Industrial Pipe Bookshelf — 3-Tier, Mango Wood
description: Three-tier bookshelf constructed from reclaimed mango wood planks and salvaged galvanised industrial pipes from a Pune factory demolition. Each pipe fitting hand-tightened, no welding. The wood shows genuine use marks and tool marks — deliberately preserved. Holds approximately 80 standard paperbacks per shelf. Dimensions: 90W x 30D x 120H cm. Self-assembly required.

title: Patchwork Wall Tapestry — Khadi Offcuts & Vintage Sari Scraps
description: Hand-stitched wall tapestry constructed entirely from khadi fabric offcuts and rescued vintage sari fragments. Each piece individually selected and quilted by hand with visible kantha stitch. Approximate dimensions 90 cm x 120 cm. Includes a concealed wooden dowel rod for hanging. No two are identical. This is an expression of radical material respect — every scrap tells a story.

title: Repurposed Tin Can Planter Set — 6 Matching Containers
description: Set of 6 reclaimed tin food cans, wire-brushed, rust-treated and hand-painted with matte chalk paint in earthy tones — forest green, ochre, raw umber, cream, terracotta and charcoal. Drainage holes drilled. Perfect for succulents, herbs or small plants on a window ledge. Each can labelled with its material origin. Ready to plant.

title: Hand-carved Teak Dining Chair — Reclaimed Wood, Cane Back
description: Solid reclaimed teak dining chair with hand-carved back rail and natural cane woven backrest. No virgin timber used — the teak was salvaged from a demolished 1960s bungalow in Mysore. Frame re-oiled, cane fully replaced, slip-seat cushion new in natural hemp canvas. Load-bearing up to 150 kg. Matching set of 4 available on request.

title: Sony WH-1000XM4 Noise Cancelling Headphones — Certified Refurbished
description: Refurbished Sony WH-1000XM4 wireless noise cancelling headphones. Battery holds 94% original capacity. All sensors, touch controls and ANC fully functional. Ear cushions replaced with OEM Sony replacement pads. Includes original charging cable, case and documentation. 6-month warranty from TechRevive Lab. Tested against full Sony diagnostic protocol. Matte Black.

title: Yashica Electro 35 Rangefinder Camera — CLA Serviced
description: Vintage Yashica Electro 35 GSN rangefinder camera. CLA (clean, lubricate, adjust) serviced in 2024 by a specialist camera technician in Kolkata. Shutter fires correctly at all speeds. Viewfinder clear, rangefinder patch sharp. Light seals freshly replaced. Film chamber clean. Yashinon DX 45mm f/1.7 lens in excellent optical condition, no haze or fungus. Tested with one roll of Kodak Gold 200.

title: MacBook Air M1 2020 — 8GB/256GB, Grade A Refurbished
description: Apple MacBook Air M1 2020 in Space Grey. Grade A refurbished — cosmetically near-perfect with one very minor hairline scratch on bottom panel not visible during normal use. Battery at 89% capacity (96 cycles). All ports functional, keyboard perfect, display bright with no dead pixels. Fresh macOS installed. Comes with compatible USB-C charger. 3-month repair warranty.

title: Godrej Almirah — Steel Wardrobe, 1980s, Completely Restored
description: Iconic Indian Godrej steel almirah from the 1980s. Fully disassembled, interior wire-brushed and treated, then powder coated in original forest green. Interior shelving all present and straight. Locking mechanism works perfectly, key provided. Rubber seals replaced. 4 shelves + hanging bar + door-mounted mirror. Dimensions: 180H x 90W x 50D cm. Self-collection from Pune only.

title: Mechanical Keyboard — HHKB Professional 2 (Topre Switches)
description: Happy Hacking Keyboard Professional 2 with Topre 45g electrostatic capacitive switches. Original Japanese layout, PFU Japan edition. Lightly used in home office. All keys functional, Topre feel perfect with characteristic bump. Printed legends sharp, no shine. Cleaned with IPA. Comes with original USB cable and dust cover. The legendary keyboard that lasts forever.

title: Ceramic Table Lamp with Linen Shade — Pre-Loved Home
description: Handthrown white stoneware ceramic table lamp base with matte glaze, paired with a natural unbleached linen drum shade. Bought from a boutique home store in 2022, used in bedroom for approximately 18 months. Electrical components in perfect working order. Base height 28 cm, shade diameter 30 cm. E27 bulb holder, any bulb compatible. No chips or cracks.

title: Deadstock Organic Cotton Fabric — 15 Metres, Natural Undyed
description: Mill surplus organic cotton twill in natural undyed state. 15 metres x 150 cm wide bolt. GOTS certified organic from Coimbatore spinning mill. Soft medium weight, 180 GSM, ideal for clothing, bags, home textiles. This is genuine deadstock from an overrun — never sold in retail. Zero pesticides, chemical-free mill processing. Sold as-is, no returns.

title: Vegetable Tanned Leather Offcuts — Mixed Lot 2kg
description: 2 kg mixed lot of vegetable tanned leather offcuts from a Dharavi leather workshop. Pieces range from 10 cm to 60 cm. Mix of natural tan, chestnut brown and black. Zero chrome, all full-grain or top-grain hide. Ideal for small accessories, patches, bookbinding or leatherwork practice. Minimum 1 kg order. Currently offering 2 kg lot at clearance price.

title: Natural Indigo Dye Powder — 500g, Neel Farmers Cooperative
description: Pure natural indigo dye powder from the Neel Farmers Cooperative, Rajasthan. Zero synthetic components. Each batch shade-tested for consistent dyeing results. Used in traditional block printing and fabric dyeing. Can dye approximately 2 kg of cotton fabric to medium depth per 100g. Sold in moisture-proof sealed pouches. Direct from farmers at fair price.

title: Kraft Paper Packaging — 500 Sheets A4, Recycled Stock
description: 500 sheets A4 recycled kraft paper, 90 GSM. Surplus from a print shop order that was cancelled. All sheets flat, unused, in original ream wrapping. 100% recycled paper content. Warm natural brown colour. Ideal for eco-packaging, wrapping, art, paper bags or stationery. Sold as one ream. Can arrange courier for extra ₹120.

title: Handloom Loom — Traditional 4-Shaft Floor Loom, Full Kit
description: Complete traditional 4-shaft floor loom, made in Varanasi. Acquired from a weaver who is retiring. Fully assembled, all heddles, beater and reed included. 90 cm weaving width. Some surface discolouration to the frame from years of use, but all mechanical parts fully functional. Requires a 3m x 2m floor space. Collection only from Varanasi — delivery possible at buyer's arrangement and cost.

title: Natural Beeswax Block — 1kg, Surplus from Apiary
description: Pure raw natural beeswax block, 1 kg, surplus from a Nilgiris apiary. Lightly filtered to remove debris, no bleaching or chemical treatment. Natural golden yellow colour and characteristic honey scent. Suitable for candle making, wood polishing, leather conditioning, batik wax resist printing and cosmetic formulations. Completely natural, single-origin, no additives.
